import math
from fractions import Fraction
from policyengine_us import Simulation
P="2026-01"
def run(net):
    s=Simulation(situation={
      "people":{"a":{"age":{"2026":35}},"b":{"age":{"2026":33}},"c":{"age":{"2026":5}}},
      "spm_units":{"u":{"members":["a","b","c"],"snap_net_income":{P:net},"is_snap_eligible":{P:True},"takes_up_snap_if_eligible":{"2026":True}}},
      "households":{"h":{"members":["a","b","c"],"state_code":{"2026":"TX"}}}})
    g=lambda v:float(s.calculate(v,P)[0])
    return {k:g(k) for k in ["snap_unit_size","snap_max_allotment","snap_expected_contribution","snap_min_allotment","snap_normal_allotment","snap_emergency_allotment","snap_if_takes_up","snap"]}
bad=0
for net in [0,1,2,3,10,33,100,101,333,500,1000,1001,1500,1666,1667,2000,2500,3000,5000]:
    r=run(net); M=r["snap_max_allotment"]
    o1=max(0,M-math.ceil(Fraction(3,10)*net))           # 273.10(e)(2)(ii)(A)(1)
    o2=max(0,math.floor(Fraction(int(round(M*100)),100)-Fraction(3,10)*net))  # (A)(2) / 2017(a)
    ok=(r["snap"]==o1==o2)
    bad+= not ok
    print(net,r,"oracle1",o1,"oracle2",o2,"OK" if ok else "MISMATCH")
print("mismatches",bad)
EOF
